_help: Paste no-approval programs from the Admitad dashboard tab 'Affiliate programs from partners' (store.admitad.com → your ad space → catalog → partners_programs). For each program click 'Get affiliate link', copy the tatrck.com link, and add an object below. Required: name, link. Optional: siteUrl, description, image, categories (array of strings). Then run: yarn partners:sync && yarn build
